title: 19 Day Kenya Turaco Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Kenya Turaco Birding Safari: 19 Stunning Days
rank_math_desc: Kenya turaco birding safari for 19 days: Ol Pejeta, Samburu, Nakuru, Bogoria, Baringo, Saiwa Swamp, Kakamega, the Mara and Amboseli. Price on request.
post_content: This Kenya turaco birding safari chases Kenya's colourful turacos from the highland forests to Saiwa Swamp and Kakamega, with big game all the way.
overview:
This Kenya turaco birding safari is a grand 19-day tour built around Kenya's most colourful birds. Turacos are the stars, from Hartlaub's turaco in the highlands to great blue and Ross's turacos in the west.

The route also covers Ol Pejeta, Samburu, five Rift Valley lakes, Saiwa Swamp, Kakamega, Lake Victoria, the Masai Mara and Amboseli.

Why choose this Kenya turaco birding safari?

  • Turacos: Hartlaub's, great blue, Ross's and black-billed turacos.
  • Saiwa Swamp: Kenya's smallest national park, with crowned cranes and Ludher's bush-shrike.
  • Kakamega: grey parrot and Turner's eremomela.
  • Rift Valley lakes: Nakuru, Bogoria, Baringo and Naivasha with Hell's Gate.
  • Masai Mara and Amboseli: big cats and elephants to finish.

Where you stay

Nairobi Safari Club, Sweetwaters Tented Camp, Sarova Shaba Lodge, Naro Moru River Lodge, Lake Nakuru Lodge, Lake Bogoria Hotel, Lake Baringo Club, a Kitale hotel, Kakamega Golf Hotel, Sunset Hotel, Lake Naivasha Country Club, Mara Sopa Lodge and Ol Tukai Lodge, or similar.

Best time for a Kenya turaco birding safari

Turacos are resident and seen all year. October to March brings migrants, while June to September is drier with excellent game viewing.

Read our Kakamega Forest guide and Lake Bogoria guide, or browse all birding safaris. Nature Kenya works to protect Saiwa Swamp and Kakamega.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi
itinerary.content: Airport pick-up, a short city orientation and an introduction to Kenya's birds at the National Museum. Overnight at Nairobi Safari Club.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Nairobi to Ol Pejeta
itinerary.content: Drive to Ol Pejeta and visit the Sweetwaters chimpanzee sanctuary. Overnight at Sweetwaters Tented Camp.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Ol Pejeta to Samburu
itinerary.content: Morning game drive at Ol Pejeta, then north to Sarova Shaba Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Samburu and Shaba
itinerary.content: A full day of birding and game viewing in the dry north.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Buffalo Springs to Naro Moru
itinerary.content: Morning in Buffalo Springs, a stop at Meru Forest, then Naro Moru River Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Mount Kenya to Lake Nakuru
itinerary.content: Mount Kenya forest for Mackinder's eagle-owl, then drive to Lake Nakuru Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to Lake Bogoria
itinerary.content: Morning at Nakuru, then on to Lake Bogoria Hotel for the hot springs.

itinerary.label: Day 8
itinerary.title: Lake Bogoria to Lake Baringo
itinerary.content: Bird walk and a boat ride at Lake Baringo. Overnight at Lake Baringo Club.

itinerary.label: Day 9
itinerary.title: Lake Baringo to Saiwa Swamp
itinerary.content: Drive west to Saiwa Swamp for an afternoon walk. Overnight in Kitale.

itinerary.label: Day 10
itinerary.title: Saiwa Swamp to Kakamega
itinerary.content: Morning at Saiwa, then a full afternoon in Kakamega Forest. Overnight at Kakamega Golf Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 11
itinerary.title: Kakamega to Lake Victoria
itinerary.content: Morning forest walk, then lakeside birding in Kisumu. Overnight at Sunset Hotel.

itinerary.label: Day 12
itinerary.title: Kisumu to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.content: Drive to Lake Naivasha with a boat ride and a walk on Crescent Island. Overnight at Lake Naivasha Country Club.

itinerary.label: Day 13
itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha and Hell's Gate
itinerary.content: Shoreline birding in the morning and Hell's Gate in the afternoon.

itinerary.label: Day 14
itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Drive to the Mara with an afternoon game drive. Overnight at Mara Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 15
itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Birding and game drives with a picnic lunch on the plains.

itinerary.label: Day 17
itinerary.title: Masai Mara to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Drive via Nairobi to Amboseli. Overnight at Ol Tukai Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 18
itinerary.title: Amboseli National Park
itinerary.content: A full day of birding and Kilimanjaro photography.

itinerary.label: Day 19
itinerary.title: Amboseli to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Drive to Nairobi for lunch and a farewell dinner, then your flight.
